india.one_line: OpenAI introduces Indian data residency as India becomes ChatGPT's largest market, alongside new voice and funding developments.

themes.title: OpenAI expands local infrastructure in India
themes.text: India has become ChatGPT's largest market globally by weekly active users, prompting OpenAI to launch local API inference residency for GPT-6 Luna workloads.

stories.headline: OpenAI adds API inference residency for GPT-6 Luna in India
India is now ChatGPT's largest market globally by weekly active users

themes.title: New voice model and venture funding
themes.text: Chariot released a multilingual text-to-speech model supporting 11 Indian languages, while Norwest closed a $4 billion fund to back AI startups.

stories.headline: Chariot launches multilingual TTS model with support for 11 Indian languages
Norwest closes $4 billion fund to back AI startups in US, India and Israel

themes.title: MeitY questions in-home video data collection
themes.text: MeitY questioned home services platforms regarding the collection of in-home video data by gig workers for training physical AI models.

stories.headline: MeitY questions home services platforms over in-home video data collection for AI
